10: เตรียมพบกับความสนุกจากการทำอาหารร่วมกันสองภาค เมื่อ Overcooked! และ Overcooked! 2 มารวมตัวกันอย่างวุ่นวาย ใน Overcooked! เล่นคนเดียวหรือร่วมมือกันบนเครื่องเดียวได้สูงสุดสี่คน ทั้งในโหมดความท้าทายแบบร่วมมือและแข่งขัน ทำอาหารหลากหลายเมนูและทำงานร่วมกันเพื่อเป็นทีมที่มีประสิทธิภาพสูงสุด ส่วน Overcooked! 2 กลับมาพร้อมความวุ่นวายในการทำอาหารชุดใหม่ เดินทางกลับสู่อาณาจักร Onion Kingdom และรวบรวมทีมเชฟเพื่อเล่นร่วมกันบนเครื่องเดียวหรือออนไลน์ได้สูงสุดสี่คน จับผ้ากันเปื้อนไว้ให้ดี เพราะถึงเวลาช่วยโลกอีกครั้งแล้ว!
15: ควบคุมรถ Mario Kart ของจริงด้วย Nintendo Switch และเห็นรถมีชีวิตขึ้นมาในเกม! แข่งรถ Mario Kart ของจริงในบ้านของคุณ ใช้เครื่อง Nintendo Switch ควบคุมรถ แล้วดูรถตอบสนองต่อสิ่งที่เกิดขึ้นในเกมขณะเร่งความเร็วและดริฟต์เพื่อคว้าชัย สนามแข่งภายในบ้านจะปรากฏบนหน้าจอจากมุมมองด้านหลังที่นั่งคนขับ
0: Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise by exploring, crafting and customizing in Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Your island paradise has many natural resources for making everything from tools to conveniences. Hunt insects at dawn, decorate your paradise throughout the day, or enjoy the sunset while fishing in the ocean. The time of day and the seasons match real life, so every day on your island offers opportunities to discover new surprises throughout the year.
1: Dive into the wildest adventure of your life in It Takes Two, a blend of adventure and platforming created specifically for cooperative play. Invite a friend to play for free with Friend’s Pass*1 and work together through a variety of playfully disruptive gameplay challenges. Play as Cody and May, a couple who do not get along, magically transformed from humans into dolls. Trapped in a fantasy world with unpredictable surprises around every corner, they are reluctantly challenged to repair their fractured relationship.
2: Discover the terrifying secrets of The Signal Tower in a horror-themed platforming adventure as Mono, a boy trapped in a distorted, broken world. Alongside Six, the raincoat-wearing heroine of the first Little Nightmares, only you can save her from fading away. As Mono and Six’s relationship develops, they must combine stealth and various items to overcome puzzling obstacles and frightening enemies. Gather your courage and face danger on a journey to stop the source of the evil spreading across the land.
6: The worldwide hit Monster Hunter series returns with new gameplay features, original monsters and a story inspired by ancient Japanese tales. Create your hunter, choose from 14 distinctive weapon types, find your Palico Felyne and new Palamute Canyne companion, and equip yourself to explore vast, detailed hunting maps. Whether playing solo or in a team of four, intelligent difficulty scaling helps keep battles fair and exciting. Each successful hunt provides materials to craft and upgrade weapons and armor, allowing you to hunt stronger monsters and obtain more valuable resources. Every version of Monster Hunter Rise provides access to numerous free content updates, including an additional story ending, new monsters, more equipment and other additions.
8: Join Mario, Luigi and friends for single-player or multiplayer fun anywhere and anytime. Enjoy two family-friendly side-scrolling adventures with up to 3 players* to protect the Mushroom Kingdom. This collection includes New Super Mario Bros. U and the faster, more challenging New Super Luigi U, both adding Nabbit and Toadette as playable characters. Two adventures in one game mean twice the fun. Simple, intuitive controls and new playable characters suited to younger, less experienced players make it accessible. Extras such as a Hints gallery and helpful reference videos* help introduce families to Mario’s world. Each player needs only one Joy-Con controller, so two players can team up immediately out of the box. Take on 164 courses across the two main modes and replay three additional modes—Challenges, Boost Rush and Coin Battle—in which Mii characters are also playable.
9: Swing, kick and dash to victory in sports that get you moving. Play with family and friends* or compete with others in this new entry in the classic Wii Sports series. Use real-world movements with Joy-Con controllers to play six sports: Volleyball, Badminton, Bowling, Soccer, Chambara (sword fighting) and Tennis. Nintendo Switch Sports offers new customization options for the Sportsmates shown in the trailer, and you can also play as your own Mii. Use a Joy-Con with the Leg Strap included with the physical game to kick in real life in Soccer Shoot-Out, or in Soccer matches after the free summer update mentioned in the source. The source also announces plans to add Golf as a seventh sport in a free autumn update.
11: Explore astonishing places far beyond the Mushroom Kingdom as Mario teams up with his new ally Cappy for an epic 3D adventure. Use new abilities, including capturing and controlling objects, animals and enemies, to collect Power Moons that power the Odyssey airship and rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s wedding plans. The brave, hat-shaped Cappy gives Mario moves such as Cap Jump, Cap Throw and Capture, bringing new possibilities to familiar running and jumping. Use captured enemies, objects and animals to overcome obstacles and discover hidden collectibles. To play with a friend, hand them a Joy-Con: Player 1 controls Mario and Player 2 controls Cappy. This 3D Mario adventure is packed with secrets, surprises and exciting new kingdoms to explore.
12: Gaming icons clash in a battle you can play anywhere and anytime. Newcomers Simon Belmont and King K. Rool join Inkling, Ridley and every fighter in Super Smash Bros. history to launch opponents off the stage. Enjoy faster combat on new stages inspired by Castlevania, Super Mario Odyssey and more. Stage Morph can change one stage into another during a battle, a feature introduced here for the first time in the series. Dark Samus, Richter Belmont and Chrom also join the fight. Enjoy faster battles, new attacks and defensive options such as perfect shielding, listen to as many as 900 music tracks, and fight a friend one-on-one, in four-player battles, in eight-player battles and more. GameCube Controllers can be used too. Legendary battles await, with play anywhere and anytime.
13: Step into a world of adventure and forget everything you know about The Legend of Zelda. Discover, explore and adventure in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, an entry that breaks the boundaries of the acclaimed series. Travel across open fields, through forests and up mountain peaks to discover what happened to the kingdom of Hyrule in this open-world adventure. Nintendo Switch gives your journey more freedom: take the system anywhere and adventure as Link in your own way.
14: Explore wide grasslands by jogging in place, attack enemies with shoulder exercises, and restore your health with yoga poses. Two accessories, Ring-Con and Leg Strap, measure real movements and turn them into actions in the game. Ring Fit Adventure includes many minigames and personalized workout schedules for players of different skill levels and routines. In Adventure mode, defeat enemies with attacks based on real exercises across more than 100 levels in over 20 worlds. Earn experience points as you progress and work up a sweat. Outside battles, discover unusual ways to travel, such as launching a platform by squatting. Pass the Ring-Con and Leg Strap around and try minigames such as blasting boxes with gusts of air, making pottery with squats and more.
16: Beat Saber is a fast-paced VR experience combining striking neon visuals, energetic music, handcrafted levels and polished action gameplay that moves to the beat. Use the two differently colored laser sabers, one in each hand, to slash incoming beats. Choose the matching color and cut in the correct direction to build combos and keep the music going to the end. As the beats become more frequent, move your whole body to dodge incoming obstacles by stepping sideways or ducking while continuing to slash in rhythm. The base game includes more than 40 songs, with additional music packs available to purchase and download featuring internationally known artists.
18: EA SPORTS FC 24 marks the beginning of a football gaming future built on innovation and authenticity. Experience realistic matches with leading players from clubs, leagues and competitions around the world. Three technologies support this realism: HyperMotionV, PlayStyles enhanced by Opta, and an advanced Frostbite engine. With more than 19,000 fully licensed players, over 700 teams and more than 30 leagues, including the UEFA Men’s and Women’s Champions League, EA SPORTS FC 24 brings the authenticity of football competition to the game.
19: In Valisthea, immense mountain-like Mothercrystals supply the inhabitants with aether. This precious resource powers the magic that has allowed kingdoms to prosper in the crystals’ light for hundreds of years. As that light begins to fade, a mysterious blight turns once-fertile land barren. The fragile alliances between realms founded around the Mothercrystals weaken as well. While the blight threatens everything they have built, an age of peace and prosperity gives way to a new era of war and uncertainty.
20: Embark on an epic, moving adventure as Kratos and Atreus struggle between holding on and letting go. From Santa Monica Studio, this is the sequel to the acclaimed God of War (2018). Fimbulwinter approaches, and Kratos and Atreus must journey through the Nine Realms for answers while Asgard’s armies prepare for the prophesied battle that will end the world. Along the way they encounter striking landscapes and formidable enemies, including Norse gods and monsters. As Ragnarök draws closer, they must choose between their own safety and the safety of all the realms.
21: Gran Turismo first launched as a realistic motor racing simulator in 1997. Its cars modeled real manufacturers’ production vehicles, and its realistic virtual driving won praise from both gamers and car enthusiasts worldwide. After 25 years and several installments, Gran Turismo returns to the series’ central ideas: driving, collecting and tuning. Gran Turismo 7 offers more than 400 cars from over 60 brands, ranging from production vehicles to rare cars and legendary racers. Cars from different eras and regions are carefully recreated in the game. Special cars have also been added through regular updates since release, offering hidden gems from the automotive world.
22: Hogwarts Legacy is an open-world action RPG set in the Harry Potter universe. Visit familiar places and explore new ones to encounter magical creatures, customize your character, brew potions, master spells, improve skills and become the witch or wizard you want to be. Enter Hogwarts in the late 1800s as a character who holds an ancient secret that could destroy the wizarding world. Experience life at Hogwarts, form friendships and battle dark witches and wizards to decide the fate of the magical world. Shape your own legacy through a story that has never been told before.
24: Experience Naruto and Sasuke’s story in full for the first time in this celebration of the Naruto anime’s 20th anniversary. NARUTO X BORUTO Ultimate Ninja STORM CONNECTIONS offers the power of Ninjutsu with more than 130 playable fighters. Master updated combat mechanics across exciting offline and online battle modes. New players and longtime fans can make history with favorite warriors through detailed character customization, and shape Ninjutsu’s future through a special Boruto story.
25: Resident Evil 4, the survival-horror classic from 2005, receives a complete update in this remake. The source says that two years after the events of RESIDENT EVIL 2, Raccoon City survivor Leon Kennedy is sent to an isolated European village to investigate the disappearance of the US president’s daughter. What he finds is unlike anything he has encountered before. Every element of the classic is updated for the modern era, from graphics and controls to a reimagined story that may surprise even devoted fans of the original.
27: Feel the force of every attack in TEKKEN 8, the latest entry in Bandai Namco’s fighting-game franchise. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, TEKKEN 8 pushes fighting games forward using the capabilities of modern consoles. New features, highly detailed characters and striking environments create an immersive visual presentation. The story continues after the battle that ended with Heihachi Mishima’s defeat in TEKKEN 7. It centers on a new confrontation between father and son as Jin Kazama challenges Kazuya Mishima’s plans for world domination.
28: Experience the emotional storytelling and memorable characters of The Last of Us, winner of more than 200 Game of the Year awards. In a collapsed civilization populated by infected people and ruthless survivors, weary protagonist Joel is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie out of a military quarantine zone. This small job becomes a brutal journey across the country. The collection includes the complete single-player story of The Last of Us and the acclaimed prequel Left Behind, which explores events that changed Ellie and her best friend Riley’s lives forever.
29: Play the winner of more than 300 Game of the Year awards, remastered for PlayStation 5. Revisit Ellie and Abby’s story or experience it for the first time, with graphical improvements, new roguelike survival gameplay in No Return mode, full DualSense wireless controller support and more. Five years after their dangerous journey across the post-pandemic United States, Ellie and Joel have settled in Jackson, Wyoming. Life in a thriving community of survivors offers peace and stability despite threats from infected people and other survivors. When a violent event disrupts that peace, Ellie sets out on a relentless journey in search of justice and closure.
30: Seek your legacy and put your name on the map in UNCHARTED: Legacy of Thieves Collection. Experience Naughty Dog’s cinematic action-adventure franchise. Discover lost history with charismatic, complex thieves Nathan Drake and Chloe Frazer as they travel the world with a sense of wonder, undertake extraordinary adventures and uncover forgotten legends. The collection includes the acclaimed single-player games UNCHARTED 4: A Thief’s End and UNCHARTED: The Lost Legacy, remastered for PS5 with detailed visuals and improved frame rates.
